metadata.title: Pencil Sketch Album Cover Style
useCases: Folk or Southern Rock album art

retrievalProfile.description: A monochromatic graphite pencil sketch featuring a central figure on a bench with arched, hand-drawn typography and high-texture cross-hatching.
excludeWhen: modern minimalist sans-serif layouts are needed

recipe.visualDefinition: A detailed graphite pencil illustration depicting an elderly man sitting on a wooden bench in front of a window. The style is characterized by visible pencil strokes, varying pressure for shading, and a monochromatic grey palette. The composition is framed by a thick grey border, with text following a curved path at the top.
coreVisualRelationships: Central seated figure anchored by a horizontal wooden bench
Arched display text mirroring the curve of the figure's hat or background elements
Vertical window frame dividing the background into distinct panes
Foreground objects like a trash bin and watering can providing depth

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: The seated man is the central focal point, scaled to occupy the middle third of the vertical space.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The horizontal lines of the wooden bench provide a stable base for the composition.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: The eye starts at the arched text at the top, follows the vertical lines of the window down to the seated figure, and rests on the foreground details.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: The grey border acts as a containment field, while the window panes provide 'breathing room' within the dense sketch.

colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: Zero saturation; value is determined entirely by pencil density and pressure.

letterConstructionRules: Letters are drawn with thick graphite outlines and filled with lighter shading
The primary text follows a distinct upward arc
Irregular widths and hand-drawn imperfections are preserved
characterSpecificRedesigns: The 'A' characters have a wide stance
The 'R' has a curved leg that mimics the overall arc of the text
typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: A secondary, smaller block-style sans-serif is used for subtitles, placed horizontally to contrast the arched main title.
graphicDevices: Horizontal divider lines for secondary text

candidateDirections.reason: Captures the raw, carved feel of the hand-drawn letters
Matches the heavy weight and blunt terminals

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: Generate a detailed graphite pencil sketch of an elderly man in a hat sitting on a wooden bench in front of a window, using cross-hatching and stippling in monochrome grey.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Add hand-drawn, arched block lettering at the top, ensuring the texture matches the pencil medium of the background.

verificationChecks: Is the medium strictly monochromatic graphite?
Does the text follow a curved arc?
Is there a thick grey border framing the image?
Are pencil strokes and textures visible?

postGenerationChecks: Check for visible pencil grain in the shaded areas
Ensure the text arc is symmetrical relative to the center
Verify the border is a solid, flat grey
Confirm the figure and background share the same illustrative style
recipe.reuseFormula: Graphite sketch medium + [Subject] + Arched hand-drawn [Typography] + Monochrome palette + Thick grey border.
